args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here is the essential packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike and other outdoor adventures)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories of beautiful Hawaii)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and sandals (Waikiki Beach day)
- Snorkeling equipment (Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable hiking shoes (Diamond Head hike)
- Light rain jacket (North Shore road trip)
- Traditional Hawaiian attire (Luau experience)
- Spa-appropriate clothing (Hotel spa day)
- Water shoes (Kayaking at Kailua Beach)
- Shopping bags (Ala Moana Center)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
